blockers.details: No runtime data has been imported.
Whether official route groups should be modeled as main loop plus three connectors, main loop plus east/north/west branches, or another route-builder topology.
Protected-area boundary overlays and live fire-ban/currentness checks are still required before user-facing runtime import.
Shared endpoint clusters, commercial/customer-only services, weak transit and unverified water/shelter records need normalization review.

openDecisions.decision: Choose the route-builder topology for Höglandsleden.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: The official distance and stage structure only make sense if the app distinguishes the ca 300 km loop from branch/connector material.

openDecisions.decision: Decide whether official access trails such as Mariannelund-HÖ3, Sävsjö C, Hok station, Byarum kyrka, Skillingaryd station and Lyngemadens naturreservat should be first-class route groups or access metadata.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: They are mentioned officially, but should not be silently merged into HÖ section geometry.

openDecisions.decision: Decide app scope for bookable/commercial services and very weak rural transit.
openDecisions.whyItMatters: Several useful services exist, but importing them as ordinary public trail facilities would overstate access.

validationChecklist: JSON parse this handoff and every changed research file.
Verify all 23 expected section files exist and match officialSectionOrder.
Check every normalized section retains source URL, official distance, computed distance and transform notes.
Verify route group distances separately for main loop, HÖ1, HÖ3 and HÖ18-HÖ23 branch.
Run endpoint-gap checks at Skuruhatt, Valbacken, Vikskvarn, Byarum/Grönelund, Åsafors and Kärringabacka.
Run duplicate facility detection for every shared endpoint cluster listed in facilityPlan.deduplicationTargets.
Confirm no private/customer-only service is imported as a public facility.
Run protected-area GIS overlays before importing static reserve/cultural-reserve rule warnings.
Recheck live fire bans, current trail clearance, transit schedules and water reliability before runtime publication.
Keep all outputs research-only until the user explicitly requests runtime integration.
